Finerenone against placebo in chronic kidney disease with type 2 diabetes: the cardiovascular composite, pooled from the two pivotal trials

In adults with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes, does finerenone reduce the first occurrence of the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or hospitalisation for heart failure, against placebo?

Pooled result

HR 0.8655 (0.7877 to 0.951), 95% interval

First occurrence of the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or hospitalisation for heart failure. random, estimator DerSimonian-Laird, k = 2.

τ² 0 · I² 0% · Q 0.01432 on 1 df

Favours: the intervention (lower is better)

Both trials report the SAME composite with the same four components in the same order, in CKD with type 2 diabetes, against placebo. Q = 0.0143 on 1 df.

Results

The pooled hazard ratio for first occurrence of the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or hospitalisation for heart failure was 0.865 (0.788 to 0.951) across 2 trials, against placebo.
← outcomes[id=cv_composite_first].name, results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.pooled, outcomes[id=cv_composite_first].comparator

Between-trial heterogeneity was I-squared 0%, tau-squared 0, Q 0.0143, degrees of freedom 1. Q = 0.0143 on 1 df: the two trials agree closely, which is what the same endpoint in one programme should look like.
← results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.heterogeneity.i2, results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.heterogeneity.tau2, results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.heterogeneity.q, results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.heterogeneity.df, results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.heterogeneity_status

The grounds for pooling are recorded as: Both trials report the SAME composite with the same four components in the same order, in CKD with type 2 diabetes, against placebo. Q = 0.0143 on 1 df. Where a later pool on this page rests on the same grounds, they are not restated.
← results.by_outcome.cv_composite_first.poolable_reason
